name: Image Placer
desc: Add pictures from your folders or SD card to any note. The picture lands selected, ready to move or resize. Crop it (free, original, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16), round its corners and rotate it from the lasso menu. Works fully offline: no internet access, and it never changes your files.
author: 82deg
